iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

SERVER_DATA
       Triggered when new data is received from the target node after TCP::collect command has been issued.

DESCRIPTION
       For TCP, this event is triggered when new data is received from the target node after TCP::collect command has been issued.
       For UDP, this event fires on receipt of each segment from the server.  Unlike TCP, no collect is required, and there is no
       release command.

Examples
	when SERVER_CONNECTED {
	  TCP::collect
	}
	when SERVER_DATA {
	  set payload [TCP::payload]
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
